class.name: Patient
class.brief_description: Patient entity with stabilization and extraction lifecycle.
class.description: Tracks patient state (CRITICAL → STABILIZED → TRANSPORTABLE → EXTRACTED), stabilization progress, and assigned medic.

method.name: start_stabilization
method.description: Assigns a medic and begins stabilization.

method.name: update_stabilization
method.description: Advances stabilization progress by delta seconds.

method.name: extract
method.description: Moves patient to EXTRACTED state if eligible.

members.member: Agent ID of the assigned medic.
Time in seconds required to stabilize.
